rationale: Reviewed the proposed run spec (current/SPEC-1.md, sha256 b073f381e9e0d89928631f42659b9f5a57b3ccbffde2b417af991287e3d2703b) against the two referenced evidence files, which I read in full in this workspace: the flattened notebook source (evidence/e2f6d75d...-notebook_source.txt, 986 lines) and the saved output transcript (evidence/6faa89dc...-result_tables.txt). No blocker found in any permitted category. Verified facts: (1) both required binding lines appear exactly once and verbatim, and the run_id matches the notebook's hard-coded acceptance package directory manual-step-d/sprint10-stepd-a9123b81e3ef32ee (source line 36); (2) every configuration pin in the spec (predecessor runs 875c56c278/0a60362503, cache feature-cache-2mm-v2, feature config, repo commit c17281a1..., CODE_VERSION sprint10-r2-exclusion-reference-v1, map shuffle 101/seed 1, PROB_TOL 1e-6, split-manifest and exclusion hashes with count 1) matches source lines 17-31 and the supplied configuration artifact; (3) the frozen statistical contract matches the actual implementation: one np.random.default_rng(0) stream (line 880), descriptive recipe summaries consume draws before contrasts, each contrast consumes Dice-mean, volume-median, then lesion-F1-mean draws (line 913), 2000 resamples, patients (not observations) resampled after within-patient averaging, volume contrast as the median of patient-mean absolute-error differences (line 915), exactly 12 contrasts with the two cross-pipeline clinical contrasts gated on clinical-input identity, matched amount taken from D's pred_ml never true volume (line 869), lexsort tie rule, full-lesion-truth evaluation and the exact conditional-NaN validation rules; (4) the acceptance contract (atol 1e-10, rtol 1e-9, exact strings/counts/order, only utc/code_version/fingerprint/run_identity metadata differences, only output-directory-prefix path difference) matches both the operator's predeclared acceptance and the supplied validator's TOLERANCE block, and the new-JSON key rule (baseline keys plus fingerprint/run_identity) matches what the source actually writes (lines 745, 921); (5) all historical numbers the spec quotes (100/100 complete fold tables, 50/50 paired, 990 rows, 10 identical partitions, D Dice 0.206, U_base smoothed 0.204, -0.002 (-0.019 to +0.014), +11.1 ml (+6.9 to +14.0), -0.010 (-0.023 to +0.003), zero matched volume-error difference) match the saved-output transcript exactly and are correctly labeled reproduced exploratory known results, not new efficacy evidence; (6) scope is correctly bounded: 99 development cases with assert retained (source lines 134 and 966), 25 final-evaluation and 24 reserve patients untouched, membership kept out of configuration/reports per the recorded operator decision, no training, no model clients, no paid resources, manual Colab CPU single pass, PROPOSAL_ONLY next decision with no ratification, launch or acceptance authored. The spec preserves open Sprint9/Sprint10 findings as open, discloses the 69/30 exposure and other limitations, and distinguishes verified inspection from the non-recomputable notebook_code_sha256 binding. Advisories (non-blocking, recorded, none concealed): (a) the spec's line-range citation 'configuration/capture 23-96' is imprecise against the flattened source (config ~17-31, capture cell ~33-75); hashes, not line numbers, are binding; (b) the source imports xgboost at definition time (line 394) although the comparison path never trains, and the capture cell's dependency preflight (line 61) omits xgboost, so a runtime lacking it would fail after the return directory is created; the existing-dependencies requirement mitigates this; (c) reproduction of the bootstrap draw order depends on pandas groupby.apply behavior in the pinned environment (deprecation warnings visible in the transcript); the spec's existing-cache/dependencies pin and the receipt's recorded package versions are the correct guard, and any resulting numeric difference would correctly fail the predeclared contract rather than be silently absorbed; (d) notebook_code_sha256 f2d78ef5... cannot be independently recomputed from the flattened source text (different hash, disclosed in the spec); it is bound through the package manifest and validator checks, status inferred-not-verified here; (e) current/SPEC-1.md and current/baseline-bindings.json are logical artifact references supplied inline in the stage input rather than standalone workspace files, which the spec itself discloses; the seven baseline byte pins therefore remain attributed evidence pending the packaged manifest, exactly as the spec's acceptance section requires. This APPROVE endorses the proposal as a bounded specification for opposing review and a subsequent source-bound manual return through the existing system; it grants no execution, scientific acceptance, amendment or human ratification.
